description: Figure 4 preliminary activation ANOVA: six Clutter models across ten seeds, with balanced condition-mean Sector/Digit/Interaction fractions for encoder and hidden activations.
notes: Amarel array 60603527 and dependent aggregate 60603528 were cancelled at the user's request after 20 completed bundles were retained.
The retained 20 Amarel bundles and all 60 checkpoints were streamed directly to SJC; SJC already owns the Clutter stimuli.
The SJC tmux session uses both RTX A6000 GPUs and skips every existing compact bundle.
Every worker streams the test split once and saves compact aggregate condition-mean ANOVA draws only; no raw activation mmap is retained.
Aggregate job 60603528 depends on successful completion of array 60603527 and renders activation_anova_1x2_6model_10seed.pdf.
